description.value: A 15-site BC Parks campground on the shore of Muncho Lake in the Northern Rockies, sitting directly off the Alaska Highway; gate is locked and services cease outside the operating season.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record links to the BC Parks Muncho Lake page, which confirms MacDonald Campground exists within the park, located 11 km north of Strawberry Flats Campground along the Alaska Highway. The website confirms the park is seasonally open (May 1–Sep 15, 2026) but carries an active advisory that drinking water is unavailable park-wide due to a diesel spill (posted April 11, 2025), making potable water status uncertain for a normal operating season. No specific amenity details for MacDonald Campground are listed on the park page, so most amenity fields default to null.
concerns: Active water contamination advisory (posted April 11, 2025): a diesel spill on Highway 97 North within Muncho Lake Park has rendered all park water sources unsafe to drink; boiling/filtering does not help. Cyclists must bring water from outside the park. Status of advisory as of directory publication should be verified.

The OSM website URL points to the parent Muncho Lake Park BC Parks page, not a dedicated MacDonald Campground page; amenity-level detail for this specific campground is absent from the fetched content.

OSM operator is listed as 'Kootenay Forest Services Ltd.' with a Gmail contact address (kootenayforestservices@gmail.com), suggesting a privately contracted operator managing a provincial park campground — worth verifying operational continuity.
No address in OSM record; campground is identified only by coordinates along the Alaska Highway.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, operating seasonal campground within Muncho Lake Provincial Park on the Alaska Highway — directly relevant to long-distance cycle tourers travelling the Alaska Highway corridor.
enrichment_extras.notes: Capacity 15 sites per OSM. Internet access confirmed as 'no' by OSM tag, consistent with the remote location. Fee applies (OSM fee=yes).
